svg.title: A design sheet: tubercles and a crushable protector
svg.desc: Brand stories as a design sheet: a paraglider planform with tubercles along the central 60% of the leading edge (the wave leading edge Gin Seok Song describes) and plain tips, and below it a pod harness in section with its crushable protector (a protector that crushes rather than springs back) and the carabiner it hangs from.
svg.text: tubercles on the central 60% of the span
